<div id="algorithm1.4.5" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 1. Freeze the parts of LoRA unrelated to the current task. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.6" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> <span id="algorithm1.4.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span> <em id="algorithm1.4.6.2" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic"><math id="algorithm1.m27" class="ltx_Math" alttext="epoch" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi>e</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>p</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>o</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>h</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">epoch</annotation></semantics></math> = 1</em> <span id="algorithm1.4.6.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">do</span>
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.7" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> <span id="algorithm1.4.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span> <em id="algorithm1.4.7.2" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic"><math id="algorithm1.m28" class="ltx_Math" alttext="t" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>t</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">t</annotation></semantics></math> = 1, …, <math id="algorithm1.m29" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>T</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T</annotation></semantics></math></em> <span id="algorithm1.4.7.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">do</span>
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.8" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 2.Draw a mini-batch <math id="algorithm1.m30" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>B</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">B</annotation></semantics></math> = <math id="algorithm1.m31" class="ltx_math_unparsed" alttext="({I}_{i}^{t},{T}_{i}^{t},{Y}_{i}^{t}\}_{i=1}^{n_{t}}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msubsup><mi>I</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>t</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>T</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>t</mi></msubsup><mo>,</mo><msubsup><mi>Y</mi><mi>i</mi><mi>t</mi></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">}</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>i</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><msub><mi>n</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">({I}_{i}^{t},{T}_{i}^{t},{Y}_{i}^{t}\}_{i=1}^{n_{t}}</annotation></semantics></math>. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.9" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> <span id="algorithm1.4.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">for</span> <em id="algorithm1.4.9.2" class="ltx_emph ltx_font_italic"><math id="algorithm1.m32" class="ltx_Math" alttext="({I},{T},{Y})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>I</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>T</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Y</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">({I},{T},{Y})</annotation></semantics></math> in <math id="algorithm1.m33" class="ltx_Math" alttext="B" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>B</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">B</annotation></semantics></math></em> <span id="algorithm1.4.9.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_bold">do</span>
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.10" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 3.Encode <math id="algorithm1.m34" class="ltx_Math" alttext="I" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>I</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">I</annotation></semantics></math> into <math id="algorithm1.m35" class="ltx_Math" alttext="I_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">I_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> by <math id="algorithm1.m36" class="ltx_Math" alttext="I_{t}=f_{vis}(I)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>f</mi><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>i</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>s</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>I</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">I_{t}=f_{vis}(I).</annotation></semantics></math> 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.11" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 4.Embed <math id="algorithm1.m37" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mi>T</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T</annotation></semantics></math> into <math id="algorithm1.m38" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> by <math id="algorithm1.m39" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T_{t}=\phi(T)." display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mrow><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mi>ϕ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><mo lspace="0em">.</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T_{t}=\phi(T).</annotation></semantics></math> 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.12" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 5.Prepend <math id="algorithm1.m40" class="ltx_Math" alttext="I_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">I_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> with <math id="algorithm1.m41" class="ltx_Math" alttext="T_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">T_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> by <math id="algorithm1.m42" class="ltx_Math" alttext="[T_{t};I_{t}]" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>;</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">[T_{t};I_{t}]</annotation></semantics></math>. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.13" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 6.Obtain autoregressive prediction by <math id="algorithm1.m43" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\hat{Y}=f_{lan}([T_{t};I_{t}])" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mover accent="true"><mi>Y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mrow><msub><mi>f</mi><mrow><mi>l</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>a</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></msub><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">[</mo><mrow><msub><mi>T</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>;</mo><msub><mi>I</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo stretchy="false">]</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\hat{Y}=f_{lan}([T_{t};I_{t}])</annotation></semantics></math>. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.14" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 7.Calculate loss <math id="algorithm1.m44" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}_{B}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mi>B</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}_{B}</annotation></semantics></math> by accumulating <math id="algorithm1.m45" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\mathcal{L}(Y,\hat{Y})" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><mrow><mi class="ltx_font_mathcaligraphic">ℒ</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>Y</mi><mo>,</mo><mover accent="true"><mi>Y</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\mathcal{L}(Y,\hat{Y})</annotation></semantics></math>. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.15" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 8.Backward propagation and update trainable parameters with optimizer. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.16" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> # Fisher information matrix calculate. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.17" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 9.Calculate Fisher matrix according to Eq.(<a href="#S4.E2" title="In 4.2 Mechanism of Anti-Forgetting ‣ 4 MAGE: An Efficient UCL Framework ‣ Continual-NExT: A Unified Comprehension And Generation Continual Learning Framework" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">2</span></a>). 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.18" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> # EMA weight calculate. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.19" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 10.Obtain regularized Hessian matrix according to Eq.(<a href="#S4.E3" title="In 4.2 Mechanism of Anti-Forgetting ‣ 4 MAGE: An Efficient UCL Framework ‣ Continual-NExT: A Unified Comprehension And Generation Continual Learning Framework" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">3</span></a>). 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.20" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 11.Calculate <math id="algorithm1.m46" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta_{t}</annotation></semantics></math> according to Eq.(<a href="#S4.E4" title="In 4.2 Mechanism of Anti-Forgetting ‣ 4 MAGE: An Efficient UCL Framework ‣ Continual-NExT: A Unified Comprehension And Generation Continual Learning Framework" class="ltx_ref"><span class="ltx_text ltx_ref_tag">4</span></a>). 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.21" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> # EMA parameter update. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.22" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 12.Update EMA parameters with parameter-wise <math id="algorithm1.m47" class="ltx_Math" alttext="\beta_{t}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>β</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\beta_{t}</annotation></semantics></math>. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.23" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> end for
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.24" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span>  <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> end for
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.25" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> end for
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.26" class="ltx_listingline"> <span class="ltx_rule" style="width:1px;height:100%;--ltx-bg-color:black;display:inline-block;"> </span> 13. Save checkpoints of <math id="algorithm1.m48" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f_{GI}^{*}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>f</mi><mrow><mi>G</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f_{GI}^{*}</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="algorithm1.m49" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f_{GT}^{*}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>f</mi><mrow><mi>G</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f_{GT}^{*}</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="algorithm1.m50" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f_{EI}^{*}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>f</mi><mrow><mi>E</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f_{EI}^{*}</annotation></semantics></math>, <math id="algorithm1.m51" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f_{ET}^{*}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msubsup><mi>f</mi><mrow><mi>E</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo>∗</mo></msubsup><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f_{ET}^{*}</annotation></semantics></math>, and <math id="algorithm1.m52" class="ltx_Math" alttext="f_{con}" display="inline" intent=":literal"><semantics><msub><mi>f</mi><mrow><mi>c</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>o</mi><mo lspace="0em" rspace="0em">​</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></msub><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f_{con}</annotation></semantics></math>. 
</div>
<div id="algorithm1.4.27" class="ltx_listingline">end for
</div>
